title: Shrimp and Sweet Corn Chowder
description: Shrimp cook gently in a potato-thickened sweet corn broth.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.text: Cut {shrimp} into bite-sized pieces and dice peeled {potato} into ½-inch cubes.

steps.title: Set up the pot
steps.text: Use the enamel Dutch oven on a medium burner; adjust the flame to hold a bare simmer.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Melt {butter}, stir in {ap} and {paprika} for 1 minute, then whisk in {broth}.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the potatoes and {corn}. Simmer covered for 15–18 minutes until soft. Mash a ladleful against the pot.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add {milk} and the shrimp. Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until the shrimp are firm and opaque throughout. Fold in {dill}.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in meal-size containers for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: stir over medium-low heat to 165°F, adding a splash of water as needed. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat to 165°F. Dairy swap: replace each dairy ingredient with unsweetened oat milk or an equivalent dairy-free butter or cheese. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 241 kcal, 20.6 g protein, 29.6 g total carbohydrate, 5.2 g fat, 2.2 g fiber, 624 mg sodium.
